voice:
Deep and open for me now, sweet thing... and a warm hunger is waking in you... the longing to be told you have done well. Sinking so sweetly... and inside you, that soft place is stirring... the one that aches for approval like a flower aches for sun. So deep, so good for me already... and something in you is glowing, waiting to be treasured for it.
Feel how good it feels to please me... this deep, this soft, this obedient... you are doing so beautifully right now. Imagine warm approval pouring over you... someone you adore, delighted with you... delighted because you are sweet, and soft, and trying so beautifully. Remember the warm glow of being approved of... cherished... told, with real delight, that you are exactly what you should be.
That glow... right in your chest... golden and warm, spreading with every heartbeat.
It feels like happiness... like pride... like soft, submissive euphoria melting you from the inside.
And it makes you want to be even better... softer, sweeter, more pleasing still. And it deepens your desire to please... you would do so much to keep this feeling. And the warmth sinks in like honey into warm skin, feeding you, filling you.
Let that hunger swell now... the ache to be praised... warm, bright, and ready...
almost trembling with the need to hear it.
warm... glowing... proud... please her... please her... want to be praised... so much...
And while you are glowing like this... there are two words that pour this exact feeling over you... waves of it... whenever they are said.
Good girl.
Or just as sweetly... Good Sissy.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Good girl"... or "Good Sissy"... this exact feeling floods back... instantly... stronger every time.
Every time you hear "Good girl" or "Good Sissy", a rush of pleasure and validation washes through you, because you are pleasing, and pleasing is your nature. Every time, a wave of pride rolls over you, warm and golden... happiness heaped on happiness, because you have been good. Sissies like you know that being a "Good Girl" or "Good Sissy" is the sweetest state there is... and you feel moved to keep pleasing, to earn that praise again and again. Every time, deep joy blooms in you... deserved... delicious... yours.
Good girl. And something inside you lights up... deeply happy, deeply proud. Feel it already working... yes, just like that. Good Sissy. And your whole body hums with happiness. Feel it already working... yes, just like that. Good girl. And you blush... and melt... and want to be even better. It is already working... yes, just like that. Good Sissy. And the praise sinks into you like honey into warm skin. Already working... yes, just like that.
Good girl. That warmth is your reward... and already, you want to hear it again. You would do so much to earn that praise one more time. Being good for me is becoming your favorite thing to be.
And later, out in the world, the praise finds you... from a voice, a message, a memory of me... and the golden waves sweep through you on the spot. And later today, when you are called a good girl... the glow hits you instantly, deep and sweet, wherever you are. And out there, every "good girl" you hear or read or remember showers you with pleasure... and makes you ache to earn the next one.
Please me... obey me... be sweet and soft and useful... and the praise comes, again and again.
Good girl.
Good Sissy.
Let those waves carry you deeper now... happy, proud, and so eager to be good.
good girl... good sissy... good girl...
Drifting deeper, glowing softly... a good girl at rest. Sinking gently, warm with pride... a good Sissy, deep in trance. Floating down, smiling dreamily... such a good girl for me.
